Thanks Maria — appreciate the list. Welcome, and glad to explore a co-sell motion with BuildFlow. I've looped in Marissa (alliances lead) and Soojin (channel ops) to help with mapping.

To move quickly, I attached a short triage checklist we use internally (redwood_triage_checklist.docx). High-level approach we use:
- Confirm active deal vs. product evaluation.
- Match buying team (platform vs. analytics vs. security) — determines motion.
- Check incumbent contracts / renewals windows.
- Prioritize where co-sell increments ARR vs. where we should stay out (small one-off deals).

Proposed next steps:
1) Soojin and Marissa will review your CSV and flag owners / active opportunities.
2) If >3 strategic overlaps (Acme, Meridian, Northbridge look strategic), schedule a 30-min co-sell alignment (we prefer Tues/Weds PT).
3) Share HubSpot deal links and any technical integration docs (we'll attach playbook to the record).

Are you able to share a short list of target SKUs or the co-sell pricing approach, or do you prefer to cover on the call?

Alex Martinez
